comment: Fleet routing policy — the ONE policy file belt + buckle both load (W1253 Amendment A).
Resolution: BUCKLE_POLICY/BELT_POLICY env (or a pinned path) → ~/.claude/local-llm/routing-policy.json → this committed default.
Owner ladder law (lesson.fanout-rate-budget): NEVER flashx — same upstream family saturates together and the tier is too expensive; buckle refuses flashx tiers defensively.
Ladders = ordered cross-group walks tried after num_retries per tier (LiteLLM 1.103.0 semantics, pinned-source verified W126/W129); allowed_fails + cooldown_time = passive outlier ejection.
The glm ladder folds the 2026-10-04/06 zai-twin rescue rows with the 2026-10-01 cloud legs (zai twin → local swarm → gpt-5.2 → claude-sonnet-5).
aids/tags are buckle-enforced (belt ignores); classes/roles/reasoning + litellm_* knobs are belt emission knobs (buckle ignores).

W1267: Z.ai 1302/1305 are GENERIC rate/overload codes — never declare them account occupancy; declared-account codes are balance/entitlement classes (e.g. 1113/1311) and stay typed errors, never pacing.

W1260.2 authenticated CONNECT egress (opaque AI TLS relay for the Sing http outbounds). Fail-closed triad — the endpoint exists only when enabled AND BUCKLE_CONNECT_TOKEN is set (machine env, 0600, never in the repo) AND allow is non-empty; otherwise no listener, no egress. Ports beyond 443 and deny_private:false are deliberate operator acts.
